criteria.R1: Reviews use stable source revisions and isolated mutable outputs without modifying the caller checkout.
criteria.R2: Cleanup reports verified stopped, surviving, unknown and deliberate preservation accurately, retaining resources still needed by owned processes.
criteria.R3: Dispatch rechecks admission after capacity waits and observes external dependency closure without blocking unrelated eligible work on failed lookups.
criteria.R4: Durable recovery facts preserve holds, pending closure, deferred obligations and fix history; resume reconciles Git/tracker evidence and reuses valid work.
criteria.R5: Source-bound evidence preserves command/configuration, outcome and location, distinguishing live/simulated/fallback and failed/unavailable checks.
criteria.R6: Reviewed verification-only tasks may finish without artificial commits while implementation tasks retain delivery requirements.
criteria.R7: Caller-owned measurement and acceptance remain explicit; completed leaves cannot close a super-auto root with outstanding required obligations.
criteria.R8: Task-base exoneration cannot erase ownership of a regression introduced earlier in the run; missing run-baseline evidence remains a gap.
criteria.R9: Immutable invocation reviews and explicit finding identities retain unresolved findings across retries until supported disposition.
criteria.R10: Deferred findings fixed elsewhere resolve only after verification; uncertain matches remain separate and rejection retains reasoning/evidence.
criteria.R11: Narrow process-class aliases preserve original text and distinguish defect identity, severity and scope.
criteria.R12: Deterministic metrics distinguish transport gaps and valid-empty data, incorporate reconciliation, and report supported partial results with observed ID discrepancies.
criteria.R13: Metrics separate latest attempt/run history, repaired/deferred/rejected findings, task landings/base absorption and execution metadata/friction.
criteria.R14: Profiler timing respects task existence and evidenced readiness, preserves unknowns, labels observed graph/concurrency scope and includes planning in diagnosis with estimates identified.
criteria.R15: Existing execution paths and caller/standalone boundaries remain covered by focused mechanics fixtures, representative agent behavior evaluations and a root integration sweep.

workspace.basis: Stable captured revisions, isolated mutable outputs; unexplained caller changes are not attributed automatically. Cleanup preserves resources when process status is unknown.

recovery.basis: Preserve scoped holds, pending closure and deferred obligations; reconcile Git/tracker facts before admitting affected work. No historical scheduler reconstruction or universal automatic clear is required.

acceptance.basis: Implementation, review, measurement and acceptance are independent. Required live checks cannot be discharged by fallback. Verification-only reviewed evidence may require no commit; missing historical baseline remains a gap.

findings.basis: Each occurrence remains until explicit supported disposition; uncertain matches stay separate; a success claim does not resolve a finding. The punch list is a projection, not a replacement database.

metrics.basis: Supported partial observations, explicit discrepancies and unknown timestamps remain. Historical graph reconstruction is expressly not required; causal estimates must be qualified.

verification.basis: Focused deterministic fixtures, representative evaluations of changed instructions and cross-component checks; examples guide selection rather than requiring every agent to run every check.

behavior.action: Caller assesses representative actual merged changed instructions with source-bound fresh-agent evidence and existing qualified trials. Preserve strict B4 0 pass/2 fail/3 ambiguous and separate diagnostic arms; do not pool, regrade, or infer live workflow behavior from fixtures.

suite.action: After current selector/resume/cleanup/metrics repairs settle, execute and record the actual required final combined-source suite. Reconcile historical aggregate command/configuration separately; retain all failed/unavailable history and source/environment differences.

review.action: Complete independent whole-epic review against the actual captured final source pair and accounted source population. Historical scoped CLEAN reviews and post-cap audit do not supply this coverage.

source-accounting.action: Parent reviews exact legacy source interpretations, complete item boundaries and supported correspondence/semantic judgments before registration. Retain strict24 and original strict failures; never manufacture a recognized historical verdict or infer emptiness.

selector.action: Finish and verify current selector/provenance repairs and real continuation/membership behavior on the final source; retain original recursive failure and narrower fallback rejection separately.

resume.action: Finish and verify current resume interruption/re-entry repairs, with durable pending closures and holds intact, then independent final review.

cleanup-metrics.action: Finish the four current cleanup/metrics corrections and verify actual retained-resource/unknown outcomes and supported reconciled metrics. Old fixture passes do not certify these new repairs.

process.action: Caller inspects final owned caller/review roots, reports stopped/surviving/unknown/kept accurately and retains resources needed by surviving or unverified owned processes. Do not invent retrospective global process absence or old PID attribution.

semantic-evidence.action: Owning reviewer judges exact source role, command/configuration, chronology, same-failure correspondence and concrete fix support. Preserve missing run-baseline and conflicting histories as gaps; no guessed baseline/owner or structural oracle.

human.action: Retain existing human phase-7 finish/branch decision and root acceptance ownership until explicitly exercised; implementation authorization and leaf closure do not replace them.
